githubIssues.title: Add bulk actions to the transactions table
githubIssues.body:
Users want to select several transactions and export or tag them.

- [ ] Checkbox per row and select-all
- [ ] Export selected as CSV
- [ ] Tag selected
githubIssues.author: u_jordan

githubIssues.title: Empty state for new accounts shows a spinner forever
githubIssues.body:
When an account has no transactions the table never stops loading.

- [ ] Show an empty state with a CTA
- [ ] Regression test
githubIssues.author: u_tom

githubIssues.title: Keyboard shortcut to open search
githubIssues.body:
Power users asked for `/` to focus search.

- [ ] `/` focuses search
- [ ] Doesn't trigger inside inputs
githubIssues.author: u_dev

githubIssues.title: Upgrade to React 19.3
githubIssues.body: Track the minor upgrade; check for deprecation warnings.
githubIssues.author: u_tom

githubIssues.title: Webhook signature check should use constant-time compare
githubIssues.body:
Use `hmac.compare_digest` for signature verification.

- [ ] Constant-time comparison
- [ ] Test with an invalid signature
githubIssues.author: u_dev

githubIssues.title: Refund reasons as an enum
githubIssues.body:
Free-text reasons make reporting hard.

- [ ] Enum with migration of existing values
- [ ] API docs updated
githubIssues.author: u_priya

githubIssues.title: Return 429 with Retry-After from the rate limiter
githubIssues.body:
Clients can't back off correctly today.

- [ ] 429 status
- [ ] Retry-After header
- [ ] Contract test
githubIssues.author: u_alex

githubIssues.title: Cache /v2/profile for 60 seconds
githubIssues.body: Profile is fetched on every screen.
githubIssues.author: u_dev

githubIssues.title: Document the reconciliation job
githubIssues.body: No runbook exists for the nightly job.
githubIssues.author: u_maya

githubIssues.title: Reschedule appointment from the email link
githubIssues.body:
Patients should reschedule without signing in.

- [ ] Signed link valid 48h
- [ ] Shows next 5 free slots
githubIssues.author: u_sofia

githubIssues.title: Booking form loses data on back navigation
githubIssues.author: u_kenji

githubIssues.title: Show stock level on product page

- [ ] 'Only 3 left' under 5 units
- [ ] Hidden when out of stock
githubIssues.author: u_sofia

- [ ] Print stylesheet
